A little help. A lot of heart.

Everyone has a part to play.

A family chore planner can turn a vague list of household jobs into clear responsibilities.

01

Start with the everyday

Choose one manageable chore, a nickname and a suitable due date. Discuss what done looks like before adding more.

02

Share the plan

Keep the shared tablet somewhere useful and use the child task view when handing it over.

03

Review together

An adult approval step can help younger children learn each task without turning the household into a competition.
